status: local process component qualified; actual Codex/model support remains open
qualification_scope: Local macOS arm64; packaged actual Connect CLI and library use an offline Codex process double against real loopback MCP. No model-account, live provider, global configuration, remote deployment or production-state operation.

retained_initial_failures.finding: Two Rust test temporary-path borrow compile errors; corrected by retaining named PathBuf values.
Three failing behaviors exposed the production child stdin EOF defect. shutdown did not close the pipe while its handle remained in scope; fixed by explicitly dropping stdin after writing.

Three passes; one fixture assumed the Python child emitted its first session ID within one second. Corrected to establish a prior session and synchronize on the adapter retained active intent, without changing host/request deadlines.
Three passes; an intermediate version of the fixture still synchronized on the already saved session ID and raced lock acquisition. Final fixture waits for completed=false; original failure retained.

proofs: Two concurrent task installations retain distinct exact host session IDs and narrow task identities. Resume loads only the saved session UUID, never --last.

Original private prompt, run ID and task/grant/installation mapping are durably saved before child spawn; session ID is saved on thread.started. Interrupted work resumes the same prompt/run ID. A missing session ID requires explicit repair rather than automatic replacement.
Actual fresh Connect launcher processes recover the original session and run intent using packaged commands; no handwritten integration glue is needed for this fixture.
Real Connect MCP returns each own task record and a bounded pending journal handle. Current revoked authority denies resuming through MCP without changing the Connect store.

Exclusive per-installation writer lock rejects a competing turn. Host timeout, a returned different session UUID, forged saved task mapping and modified skill assets preserve the original mapping and fail.

The existing grant bearer is supplied only through the child environment; raw provider/Connect operator credentials are not inherited. The exact bearer is redacted from private JSONL event values. Completion is labelled host-turn-completed, never Connect task completion.
Current Connect launcher help and installed Codex CLI start/resume help parse the actual argument layout without starting a model or connecting MCP.

review.boundaries: Host state, installation and subprocess orchestration remain CLI adapter modules; none imports Store or mints communication authority.
review.budgets: Host-turn 1–300 seconds, default120; unchanged MCP ten-second tool/startup limits. JSONL stream4MiB per attempt/512KiB per event; prompt32KiB. These are declared bounds, not stable-load qualification.
review.recovery_limit: Host observation is emitted after a tool event. This adapter alone does not prove the actual model persisted mutation IDs before invocation or reconciled unknown acceptance. Current private state is single-writer, not a distributed state store.

not_claimed: Actual Codex skill loader, inference, account authentication or supported model-host behavior
Whole G4-018/G4-021/G4-023/G4-034, A4 or T-A acceptance closure
Persisting model mutation intent before actual invocation, entire child-process-tree termination or external exactly-once delivery
